description: Ranks US cities for rental investors by PulseReal Pulse Score, short-term rental cash-on-cash, occupancy or nightly rate, long-term gross rent yield, forecast 12-month appreciation, or affordability. Omit state for a national ranking. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

maxMedianPrice.description: Only markets with a median sale price at or below this, in USD.

strategy.description: "ltr" for long-term rentals, "str" for short-term (Airbnb, Vrbo).
